name: Perceptually Motivated Image Matting Benchmark
description: An image matting benchmark that evaluates matting algorithms using perceptually motivated metrics and an online evaluation framework.
general_score_metric: perceptual composite score (e.g., SAD / MSE / connectivity/gradient errors)
reputation: A well-known, widely cited benchmark in the image matting community used as a standard testbed for matting algorithms since CVPR 2009.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; relatively small/older dataset; uses multiple specialized perceptual metrics sensitive to trimap quality; not directly comparable to generic segmentation benchmarks.
